historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved, 4-2, keeping the nine GTE Mobilnet cellular antennas installed in 1995 on the roof of the six-storey, 72-foot building, which held a meat market, storage and parking on the ground floor and 28 apartments above (Motion 14203).
